mapper.select: with ledger_totals as ( select product_id, sum(quantity_delta)::bigint as ledger_quantity from stock_ledger group by product_id ) select product.id as product_id, product.sku as sku, product.name as product_name, stock.quantity as current_quantity, coalesce(ledger.ledger_quantity, 0) as ledger_quantity, stock.quantity - coalesce(ledger.ledger_quantity, 0) as difference, stock.quantity = coalesce(ledger.ledger_quantity, 0) as consistent from products product join stocks stock on stock.product_id = product.id left join ledger_totals ledger on ledger.product_id = product.id order by product.id
